detail: Change to a bounded hosted diagnosis strategy after observing a separate cold-start consent race and unavailable local shell. Validate immutable events with exact canonical control revision in Actions before publishing them. Wait up to60seconds for either normal dialog or observed authorization; retain normal OS permission and every route assertion. Measure network handle, source address, per-family sockets and public kernel rules inside the live offline test before assertion teardown; preserve provider gates and accepted gateway. No old-SHA rerun, no system consent bypass or live fixture. Production routing changes require the resulting evidence.
